kernel rb7t (UUID 20C5385B, debug.b580.fds=1), Mesa vb1 = prod8 + 0089-0092 + 0095-0100 (shim xemac-fd2, intel-rt on), Khronos loader /usr/local/lib/libvulkan.1.dylib; installed prod9 Mesa = this minus 0092 (DGC, no CTS effect)
3145441 cases ran: 1772948 pass, 1372354 not supported, 0 crash, 50 timeout, 84 fail · shard groups stopped early (partial): g183_spirv-assembly

full CTS 1.4.7.1 from the start; g183 spirv-assembly stopped after 50 timeouts (constant_data count_262128 > 60 s per case), the rest of that group not run; video tests compiled out in this deqp-vk (separate video kit)
one cell = 79 cases (per sub-group and result); every fail, timeout and warning keeps at least one cell
